color_contract: Raw linear RGB. Unlike the pinned reference display visualization, no diagnostic channel is converted to sRGB.

channels.Material ID: Stable engine material-index hash in RGB.
channels.Base Color: Evaluated linear base color in RGB.
channels.Geometric Normal: World geometric normal encoded as 0.5 * N + 0.5.
channels.Shading Normal: Final normal-mapped world normal encoded as 0.5 * N + 0.5.
channels.Roughness: glTF perceptual roughness, squared anisotropic alpha-x, squared anisotropic alpha-y.
channels.Specular F0: Effective dielectric specular scalar times colored F0 in linear RGB.
channels.Alpha/Coverage: Per accepted candidate: evaluated raw alpha, transport opacity after transmission, and the candidate acceptance probability. Accumulated blend pixels are coverage-weighted because rejected candidates continue traversal, so a blend value p contributes p only on its accepted fraction rather than displaying an unconditional raw p.
channels.Transmission: Specular transmission, diffuse transmission, combined transmission.
channels.Iridescence: Factor, thickness divided by 1200 nm, IOR divided by 3.
channels.Emission: Primary self-lit contribution after throughput and hit MIS; unlit base color is classified here.
channels.Direct Environment: Primary background or post-visibility environment NEE contribution.
channels.Indirect Radiance: All radiance contributions after the first surface.
channels.Path Depth: Visited surface count divided by configured maximum depth.
channels.BSDF PDF: Log-encoded path-sampled, direct-NEE-evaluated, and emissive-NEE-evaluated BSDF PDFs.
channels.Light PDF: Log-encoded direct mixture PDF, punctual-technique flag, environment-technique flag.
channels.Emissive PDF: Log-encoded emissive solid-angle PDF, valid-sample flag, reserved zero. PDF encoding uses 0 for invalid, 0.75 for Dirac, and 0.05 through 0.50 for finite positive values.

classifications.subject: raw-linear diagnostic output versus reference display visualization
classifications.expectation: Conformance comparisons use raw linear values; compatibility reports may apply the reference sRGB display transform offline.

classifications.subject: native specular-glossiness, fractional specular F90, and coated emission
classifications.expectation: M7 attributes and freezes the mismatch; M8 owns the semantic correction.

classifications.subject: glTF sampler import and generated tangent discontinuities
classifications.expectation: M7 focused probes expose current behavior; M9 owns imported sampler semantics and MikkTSpace-compatible generation.

classifications.subject: alpha-blend candidate ordering between traversal techniques
classifications.expectation: Opaque and mask interiors must match tightly; blend-edge differences and the coverage-weighted Alpha/Coverage accumulation remain explicitly identified until the shared RNG dimension scheme lands.

classifications.subject: unclamped high-energy transport outliers in the 64-SPP diagnostic atlas
classifications.expectation: Gate every transport term separately with mean, 99.9th-percentile, maximum, and high-energy tail-count bounds. Direct environment and direct emissive remain under tight conformant bounds; retain the established clamped 512-SPP Bistro relative-L2 gate separately.

classifications.subject: RTX and RayQuery material evaluation through the shared integrator
classifications.expectation: Deterministic interior material ROIs match within the committed M7 tolerances and forced query-only remains exact.
